label: IoT Sensor Simulator
info:
Generates one simulated sensor reading every second and POSTs it to the Express backend.

Flow:  inject (1s) -> function (generate) -> http request (POST) -> debug (response)

NOTE on the 'POST /api/data' node's URL:
- Running Node-RED NATIVELY (npx node-red / node-red, no container) -> use http://localhost:3000/api/data
- Running Node-RED INSIDE DOCKER (e.g. the official nodered/node-red image) -> 'localhost' means the container itself, not your host machine, so use http://host.docker.internal:3000/api/data instead (Docker Desktop's special DNS name for reaching the host).
